description: This file is a shell script used for testing git rebase operations involving character encoding changes (i18n). It sets up a test repository with multiple branches and commits, and performs rebase operations while changing commit encodings (e.g., eucJP, UTF-8, ISO-2022-JP), verifying correct handling of encoding updates during rebases.

methods.name: compare_msg
methods.description: Compares the expected message file with the actual commit message after rebase, converting encodings to verify correctness.

methods.name: test_rebase_continue_update_encode
methods.description: Automates the process of rebase --continue after conflict, updating commit encodings, and verifying the final commit message shows correct encoding handling.
